you-want-to-get-beat-hurtily-boss: When the first event comes up (after the cyborgs revive twice), pick "Investigate the factory." Then, once Hurtily is staggered, the control panel asks "DO YOU LOVE THE CITY YOU LIVE IN?": press "No" three times. The factory shuts down and the cyborgs stop reviving, with no damage to you. (Five presses in total blows the factory up instead: same result, but every Identity loses 20 HP. "Keep fighting" in the first event means they keep reviving.)
